summary: Whole-story retrospective annotation of the snow delivery, interrupted race, joint freeing and new shared race. Explicit local states, quoted claims, prevented outcomes and promises remain distinct.

ambiguities.issue: Red sled ownership is not established; Vale receives it and grants the later loan. Initial custody does not establish a prior loan.
Recipient of Wren original request is unstated; Vale reporting it does not prove he was the original addressee.
Tomas attributes his earlier loss to snow. This remains his excuse, not narrator-established causation.
Helped summarizes Tomas contribution to joint freeing; divided-labor binding preserves his individual subject within the shared episode.
Before they knocked does not prove a knock eventually happened; the knocking remains anticipated.
Tea supplies and served tea use separate IDs; brewing and material identity are not narrated.
Gift bread may come from the earlier loaf, but no source-part identity is asserted.
Disappearance and repeated tipping are prevented/avoided possibilities, not extra actual mishaps.
Return before dark is instructed; the story ends during the new race, with no return or winner shown.

feature_gaps.meaning: qualitative texture, tightness and visual state
feature_gaps.resolution: Use lexical glosses/legacy attributes where no precise catalog dimension exists; do not misuse material hardness for roughness.

feature_gaps.meaning: individual contribution summarized as joint help
feature_gaps.resolution: Reuse event_divided_labor plus a shared episode ID; a standard event-part convention would reduce ad hoc internal keys.

prompt_feedback: Negation operators should target positive content propositions; negating a proposition already stating nonfinish creates double negation.
Same-event reference can retain a different local grammatical subject for one member contribution; distinguish shared actor group from the member being credited.
Before X happened can introduce a prevented or unobserved action; inspect context rather than assign all past morphology actual factuality.
Collective event actors and body-part grammatical subjects need explicit bridges; do not copy actor into grammatical subject.
coverage_notes: All849 words explicitly tagged and all36 paragraphs reread; rich sparse semantics use the full catalog as available. No causal masking, paid API, exact emotion scores, invented ownership, winner or unseen return. Spaces and punctuation are lossless synthetic records.
